question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

My son __has been sleeping__ for twelve hours at a stretch.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"No improvement required"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, "No improvement required" is the case of the given sentence.
 
• The underlined part of the sentence needs no improvement as it is grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the right alternative.
